| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 10 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

*NCFS (lig147 & ligN40w107)*

From the previous optimisation:

Per reaction:

0.9 uL SAM \+ 0.02 uL Hia5 \+ 1.88 uL Hia5 buffer

Totally for 840 reactions ⇒ 756 uL SAM \+ 16.8 uL Hia5 \+ 1747.2 uL Hia5 buffer (2520 uL)

Mix thoroughly before making aliquots → Split into 26 uL per well of 4ti96 plate

Approx. the volume per reaction is 35 uL. Incubate at 37 C for 75 mins → Purify with MinElute columns.

*NOTES*

- The NUNC plate measurements were adjusted so as to deposit the smaller volumes in the plates efficiently.  
- I need to make the deposit of the octamer and DNA more efficient \- because we are still seeing some droplets remaining at the ends of the  

Seal the plates 4.2 s NUNC and shake at 1900 rpm, 40 mins.

Post reconstitution washing:

Prepare and cool 4 L of 1X Wash Buffer (2L ⇒ 200 mL 10X Buffer \+ 1800 mL water \+ 400 uL 2-ME). Mix and cool at 4 degrees.
